data.sub: Chhath puja ka sandhya arghya aaj, kayi shahron mein tay samay par.

chat.say: Prasad time par taiyar rakhna sabke liye!
Thekua khane ke liye ghar kab jana hai?

data.asar: Thekua khane ka moka nahi chhodenge, baki sab baad mein.
data.caption:
Chhath Puja katyohar shuru ho gaya hai! 

✨ Bihar mein 10 hazaar ghaton par puja
✨ Bhilwara mein 12 hazaar log shamil
✨ Sandhya arghya aaj sampann

Thekua bina festival adhoora lagta hai.

Apne dost ko tag karo jo sirf prasad khane ke liye intezaar karta hai!
